description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSkill entity class for the OrangeHRM system using Doctrine ORM. It maps the 'hs_hr_emp_skill' database table and includes properties and methods related to employee skills, such as employee reference, skill reference, years of experience, and comments.

classes.name: EmployeeSkill
classes.description: Entity class representing employee skills, including mappings to database columns and relationships to Employee and Skill entities.

methods.name: getDecorator
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeSkillDecorator instance for this entity.

methods.name: getYearsOfExp
methods.description: Retrieves the years of experience for this skill.

methods.name: setYearsOfExp
methods.description: Sets the years of experience for this skill.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves the comments associated with this skill.
